evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies chainstate database maintenance in src/dbwrapper.cpp, src/txdb.cpp, and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Prevents node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by background chainstate compaction exhausting available disk space. As documented in #36585, background compaction requires up to double the database's space, causing out-of-disk failures on nodes running with tight storage margins.
